venture.name: OpenAI
venture.team: A for-profit company under a nonprofit foundation; several thousand people.
venture.current_state: ChatGPT passed 900M weekly active users (March 2026). Revenue run rate reported above $25B by March 2026, enterprise over 40% of revenue. Atlas browser retired August 2026 and Sora shut down; Codex and the ChatGPT Work agent folded into one ChatGPT desktop app. Ads in Free and Go tiers since early 2026. First device promised for late 2026. No S-1: figures are press reports, not filings.

core.source: OpenAI's mission statement plus its product behaviour; our wording.
core.promise: Anyone can get a capable AI that helps with nearly anything, free at the point of use, and builders get the same models through an API.
core.promised_to: Everyone: consumers first, then businesses and developers.
core.must_not: Unsafe AGI, and answers bent by commercial interest (OpenAI says ads will not influence responses).
core.competence: Frontier model research at very large compute scale, joined to the largest consumer AI habit (ChatGPT).
